right.name: Drugs
items: Dose zyada, asar der se · pehle 2 hafte anxiety badh sakti

slides.note: Lorazepam: fast, ~2 h, dependence sabse zyada · Diazepam: ~1 h mein, 12 h tak · Pregabalin: alternative (dependence bhi)

slides.title: OCD vs PTSD

left.name: OCD
items: Obsessions: baar baar aane wale, unwanted vichaar, 'apne' maane jaate
Compulsions: anxiety kam karne ke liye ritual (hand-washing, checking)
High-dose clomipramine / SSRI + exposure response prevention

right.name: PTSD
items: Life-threatening event ke din se mahino baad

slides.note: Acute stress reaction: 'daze' → kuch din mein theek · Adjustment disorder: stressor ke 1 mahine ke andar · Routine debriefing nuksaan kar sakti hai
